title: TypeScript SDK: streaming-friendly type generation, runtime discriminators, and Zod/JSON‑Schema adapters
creator: Avery Chen
description: Add a streaming-first TypeScript type generator and runtime helpers that make discriminated unions safe for streamed structured outputs. Provide Zod and JSON‑Schema adapter helpers to validate/parse partial streaming chunks and final assembled objects. Surface ergonomic APIs for retries and backoff when JSON parse errors occur during streaming.
comments: 2026-02-25 - Kickoff: Alignment with PM and Design. Scope: (1) typegen emits nullable + incremental parse types, (2) runtime discriminator helper that works on partial objects, (3) zod/json-schema adapter that can validate top-level and incremental fragments, (4) retry hooks for parse failures during stream consumption.

2026-03-01 - Architecture proposal posted: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/TS/Streaming+Typegen+and+Discriminator+Proposal. Key trade-offs: performing validation in the stream consumer vs. delaying until full payload available. We agreed to make both available but default to a streaming-optimised path that validates only discriminator + required fields early.

2026-03-03 - Spike results: generator can emit three artifact types: FullType, PartialFragment<T>, and StreamCursor helpers. Measured added bundle size: +9KB gzipped for consumers who opt into runtime checks. Perf: parsing-first-pass adds ~1.8ms p95 on a 512-token stream but saves downstream recovery cost for malformed fragments.

2026-03-05 - PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tsdk/pull/4124. Implements generator + runtime helpers + zod adapter. Includes unit tests for discriminated unions (tagged by _type field and by explicit discriminatorPath).

2026-03-08 - Design feedback from @Liam O'Connor: prefer explicit opt-in for aggressive corrections (auto-merge fragments) to avoid surprising mutations. Added runtime option {fragmentMerge: 'none' | 'lenient' | 'strict'}.

2026-03-10 - QA found flakiness with backpressure + retry: when stream disconnects during a middle fragment, retry logic must be idempotent and aware of KV-cache prefixes. Added a retry token to the stream handshake and tests to validate resume semantics.

2026-03-12 - Code review: @Denise Patel requested clearer separation between parser errors (bad JSON) and semantic validation errors (zod/json-schema). Added ParserError and ValidationError classes and updated docs. Leaving for final approval.

Next steps: Address minor nits in PR, add example in README showing using zod adapter with a chat streaming scenario (function-calling + structured output), and schedule a short demo during eng sync week of 2026-03-22.
